scope: Read-only extraction of existing local measurement records and hashes of selected reviewed files. No new GPU timings. A file hash identifies the reviewed contents, not the execution-time source state of historical measurements. The shared checkout has unrelated uncommitted work.

variogramFitComparisons.method: Updated resident empirical bins; GPU encode/submit/completion versus actual concurrent three-buffer readback + CPU three-model fit + fitted parameters upload/completion. CPU fixed60 refinements; GPU convergence may stop earlier. Validation output readback excluded from both. Both use same device and warmed caches.
